checks.name: each independent runtime lists only its server-owned resources
foreign valid bearer fails authentication in the other runtime
guessed valid foreign resource IDs fail before data access
forged identity/header/workspace claims do not change the principal
scope-limited credential cannot obtain control resource access
missing bearer and corrupt or mismatched private policy fail closed without affecting the other owner
oversized or hard-linked policy is refused without changing the other owner
concurrent edits with the same revision yield one update and one visible conflict
concurrent background callbacks retain the immutable initiating principal
revocation fences accepted background work and closes its existing stream

limitations: two fixture HTTP runtimes; not installed FLUJO
separate OS processes are not hostile-code/host filesystem isolation
no browser identity provider/session/key lifecycle verified
background callback is controlled IPC, not durable schedule/worker restart recovery
source bearer remains in the fixture Request; production stream witnesses must use Security recheck contract
